name: safebox-base
description: Base npm packages for the Safebox AMI runtime — document generation, image processing, archival, email, data transformation. Locked via package-lock.json with integrity hashes verified at install time by `npm ci --ignore-scripts`.

scripts.preinstall: echo 'Do not run npm install on this package — use `npm ci --ignore-scripts` only. Lifecycle scripts are disabled to prevent supply chain attacks (e.g. TanStack May 2025).' && exit 0
